import json, pathlib, subprocess; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd(); fz = repo / 'target/debug/fz'; desktop = repo.parent; projects = [
    ('fzyagent', desktop / 'fzyagent', ['help']),
    ('superctx', desktop / 'superctx', ['help']),
    ('megaserver', desktop / 'megaserver', ['schema-version']),
    ('strand', desktop / 'strand', ['help']),
]
for name, root, smoke_args in projects:
    verify_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'verify', str(root), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
    verify_payload = json.loads(verify_proc.stdout.strip())
    assert verify_proc.returncode == 0, (name, 'verify', verify_proc.returncode, verify_payload, verify_proc.stderr)
    assert verify_payload['errors'] == 0, (name, verify_payload)
    assert verify_payload.get('warnings', 0) == 0, (name, 'verify-warnings', verify_payload)
    build_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'build', str(root), '--backend', 'llvm', '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
    build_payload = json.loads(build_proc.stdout.strip())
    assert build_proc.returncode == 0, (name, 'build', build_proc.returncode, build_payload, build_proc.stderr)
    assert build_payload['status'] == 'ok', (name, build_payload)
    binary = root / '.fz' / 'build' / name
    smoke_proc = subprocess.run([str(binary), *smoke_args], cwd=str(root), capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert smoke_proc.returncode == 0, (name, 'smoke', smoke_proc.returncode, smoke_proc.stdout, smoke_proc.stderr)

host_suite = desktop / 'megaserver' / 'tests' / 'host.pass.fozzy.json'
host_proc = subprocess.run(['fozzy', 'test', '--det', '--strict', str(host_suite), '--json'], cwd=str(desktop / 'megaserver'), capture_output=True, text=True)
host_payload = json.loads(host_proc.stdout.strip())
assert host_proc.returncode == 0, ('megaserver-host', host_proc.returncode, host_payload, host_proc.stderr)
assert host_payload['status'] == 'pass', host_payload

strand_host = desktop / 'strand' / 'tests' / 'host.pass.fozzy.json'
strand_host_proc = subprocess.run(['fozzy', 'test', '--det', '--strict', str(strand_host), '--json'], cwd=str(desktop / 'strand'), capture_output=True, text=True)
strand_host_payload = json.loads(strand_host_proc.stdout.strip())
assert strand_host_proc.returncode == 0, ('strand-host', strand_host_proc.returncode, strand_host_payload, strand_host_proc.stderr)
assert strand_host_payload['status'] == 'pass', strand_host_payload

print('compiler-parent-canaries-ok')
